# 3000 Studios VIP

> 3000 Studios is an independent, AI-driven music and media studio based in
> Acworth, Georgia, run by Jeremy Swain. The studio releases original music
> (new singles weekly, streaming on every platform), produces cinematic music
> videos, broadcasts live shows, and develops Thunder Dome: AeroStrike, a
> top-down arena shooter game. Every song previews free for one minute
> on the site; full songs stream on Apple Music, Spotify, and Amazon.

## Key pages

- [Home — Official Music & Live Stage](https://3000studios.vip/): The full catalog, live stage, official videos, and VIP visuals.
- [Music Vault](https://3000studios.vip/music): Stream every official 3000 Studios release free.
- [Video Vault](https://3000studios.vip/video): Official music videos and Thunder Dome cinematics.
- [Live Stage](https://3000studios.vip/live): Watch 3000 Studios live broadcasts.
- [Podcast](https://3000studios.vip/podcast): The 3000 Studios Podcast — every episode.
- [Beat Packs](https://3000studios.vip/beats): License 3000 Studios instrumentals and bundles.
- [Thunder Dome](https://3000studios.vip/thunder-dome): Thunder Dome: AeroStrike — the top-down arena shooter with 24 bosses.
- [Shop](https://3000studios.vip/shop): Merch, singles, and studio services.
- [Blog](https://3000studios.vip/blog): News, stories, and studio notes.
- [Community Requests](https://3000studios.vip/requests): Request a song, video, or cover.
- [About](https://3000studios.vip/about): The studio story.
- [Contact](https://3000studios.vip/contact): Booking, sync licensing, sponsorships, and press.

## Catalog

- 51 published songs, each with its own page under https://3000studios.vip/song/<slug>
  (for example [Code Red](https://3000studios.vip/song/code-red)).
- Full index of indexable pages: https://3000studios.vip/sitemap.xml
